name: Manacling Tineleft
description: Cup the tines under a descending edge and close them before the blade can slide free.

name: Wristcloak
description: Brace the shaft on the forearm so qi carried in the arm turns a cut into a dull knock.

name: Hastening Wrest
description: Anchor the lead foot behind the opponent's heel while a catch holds the arm above.

name: Verity Handknob
description: Let the tines bite the edge and sense which way the steel wants to slide.

name: Subduing Pinion
description: Snare a blade in the tines and keep it wrapped with a slow circle of qi in the wrists.

name: Rumble Twist
description: Catching a spearhead in the fork and twisting rips the haft out of the leading hand.

name: Blazeprong
description: Hold a blade fast with one sai and hammer the opponent's elbow with the other.

name: Crippling Crossprong
description: Close both sai round a weapon arm so the crossed tines form a cage the opponent cannot slip.

name: Pinionbarrage
description: Open the cage on a burst of qi so the arm flies back and the free prong lashes the ribs.

name: Veeleap
description: Slip inside the point of a spear along its shaft before the thrust can be withdrawn.

name: Gust Hiltpoint
description: Knock a pike head aside with the flat of the sai and step into the gap.

name: Gyve Snag
description: A slashing haft stops dead on the tines and is held against the sai's own shaft.

name: Steadfast Tineright
description: Crouch behind crossed sai so a sweeping polearm passes harmlessly overhead.

name: Perceptive Sanguard
description: Breathe with the swing of a long weapon and mark the moment when its reach is spent.

name: Soaring Clasp
description: Run the tines up the haft toward the hands and strike the knuckles with the butt-knob on arrival.

name: Aegis Crossprong
description: Cross both sai against a halberd's axe blade and bear it to a dead stop with set qi.

name: Staggering Handknob
description: Push the haft wide with the fork and sweep the lead foot from under the wielder.

name: Solid Prongbase
description: Cross from outside the spear's reach to point-blank in one qi-assisted step and plant the prong under the ribs.

name: Dominating Wrest
description: Wheel both sai round the haft in opposite directions and tear the long weapon from the wielder's hands.

name: Furrowing Centerprong
description: Send a thin line of qi past the central prong so the jab reaches a hand's breadth farther.

name: Iron Tinecrook
description: The qi field flares over the tines and meets a blow a moment before the metal does.

name: Pinionspurt
description: Withdraw with the field trailing the sai so a pursuing cut meets resistance in the air.

name: Chimewrist
description: Brush the living field across the opponent's guard to learn which hand leads.

name: Thorn Tineleft
description: Cast the field between the tines like a net and snag a thrown weapon in flight.

name: Unshaken Handknob
description: Fork and field return a blow's force in a pulse that stuns the striker's arm.

name: Twistassault
description: The field stretches the central prong into a thin lance that pierces a guard past the sai's true reach.

name: Suppressing Sidehook
description: Cross the sai and spread the field over the join so everything inside the cross is held still.

name: Prongtorment
description: Start a thread of qi at the shoulder and let the jab pull it out along the prong.

name: Ironwrist
description: With the thread run through the crossbar a hard cut meets a guard that gives and then holds.

name: Snagthrash
description: Tick the tip of the prong at a gap in armor and pass a thread of qi through it.

name: Glancing Pinion
description: Follow the thread one step in so the body lands where the prong has already been.

name: Needling Tineright
description: The thread drags the butt-knob down heavy onto a shoulder that is slow to rise.

name: Discerning Prongbase
description: Feel the thread draw tight when an opponent is about to strike and ease off or lean in.

name: Hoarfrost Wrest
description: Wind a thread of qi round a trapped blade and draw it tight until the edge cannot swing.

name: Resilient Crossprong
description: Pass a thread between both sai so a cut that crosses it is parted and thrown wide.

name: Scorching Handknob
description: A taut thread snaps the butt-knob forward in a flat rap against the temple.

name: Sanguard Hauberk
description: Weave many fine threads of qi round the body until the sai move inside a net no blade can enter.

name: Nova Tineleft
description: Pull a thread through the opponent's guard and ride it with the prong in one straight deep impale.

name: Cleaving Tinecrook
description: Two sai jab on two tracks at once with the left aimed high and the right aimed low.

name: Immovable Sanguard
description: Circle both sai in a basin ring before the body so cuts from any quarter find a guard.

name: Torrent Hiltpoint
description: Slip aside as water slips round a stone and leave the sai in place to take the blow.

name: Enduring Tineright
description: Parry with both hands in mirror and send the cut away to either side.

name: Wristthrash
description: Tap both butt-knobs in turn against one forearm until the fingers open.

name: Mindful Crossprong
description: Hold a sai tip to each side of the sword's line and learn its reach from the touch.

name: Quelling Sidehook
description: Embrace a sword in the forks of both sai and draw it down as the hands travel apart.

name: Equipoise Handknob
description: Cross the sai like two currents meeting and throw the incoming blade across its owner's body.

name: Rupturing Tineleft
description: Roll both sai over the forearms one after another so each blow lands on the heels of the last.

name: Careening Twist
description: Slide along two tracks at once with one sai covering the sword and the other thrusting for the belly.

name: Gyvepinion
description: Seal a weapon in a basin of crossed tines and qi so it can be neither drawn nor turned.

name: Harpooning Nova Crossprong
description: Both prongs thrust along two converging lines that meet at a single point of the opponent's guard.

name: Snagassault
description: Drop on the target from above like a stooping hawk and jab the prong down through the guard.

name: Hardened Sanguard
description: Hold the pair together as one shield with the qi field spread across the join.

name: Wristjaunt
description: Land on the toes like a talon on a branch and be inside the sword's reach.

name: Waning Tineright
description: Spread the field wide across the practice court and note every shift of weight within it.

name: Murk Prongbase
description: Spread both sai like wings and beat a flurry of cuts out of the air.

name: Paralyzing Hiltpoint
description: Set the tines on a sleeve like talons and pin the arm until the opponent stops struggling.

name: Clasptorment
description: Peck both prongs in turn at the same joint of armor until the plate gives.

name: Interlocking Tinecrook
description: Two linked strikes follow a fleeing opponent so the second sai catches what the first missed.

name: Transfixing Sidehook
description: Leap and fall with both prongs set together so the pair pins the opponent's shoulder to the ground.

name: Surging Clasp
description: Turn on a curved line like a river bend so the sai swing round the opponent's guard.

name: Annealed Tineleft
description: Guard the outer track with the lead sai while the rear sai watches the inner line.

name: Might Centerprong
description: Jab the rear sai down the inner track the instant the outer one draws the eye.

name: Staunch Crossprong
description: Plant both sai like stones in a ford so a rush must break around them.

name: Sustaining Handknob
description: Skim the sai through the opponent's guard like fingers through shallow water and feel the eddies of intent.

name: Snagplating
description: Spin the tines into a small eddy that draws a sword out of an unready hand.

name: Unflinching Tinecrook
description: Turn the force of a thrust into the current of the sai's spin and let it run past.

name: Twisttorment
description: Bring both butt-knobs from separate tracks onto the same ribs in one beat.

name: Ponderous Twist
description: Loose a flood of fast jabs along both tracks until the opponent can only guard and give ground.

name: Treacherous Sanguard
description: Set the sai crossed and upright in the ground so a charging opponent runs onto the tines.

name: Prongassault
description: Jab with the wind at the back so the prong arrives before the sound of the step.

name: Mantled Tineright
description: Let the field lean into the wind and turn a cut aside as a gust turns a leaf.

name: Bounding Handknob
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and close along it without veering a hand's breadth.

name: Remnant Hiltpoint
description: Read the opponent's intent from the stir of air at the tines as a sailor reads a breeze.

name: Stifling Centerprong
description: Snap the fork shut in a gust of qi round a blade and hold it as in a clenched fist.

name: Adamant Hiltpoint
description: Sweep the tines across the line of a thrust like a crosswind and send it past.

name: Dominating Prongbase
description: Hold a caught weapon in the fork with the whole field clamped on it until the wielder lets go.

name: Wresttorment
description: Push off the rim of a step with all the weight forward and punch the prong through plate.

name: Grinding Tineleft
description: Fix a bearing on the opponent's belt and jab along it without wavering.

name: Implacable Tinecrook
description: Plant the crossbar across the rush of an attack and break it against the tines.

name: Veepounce
description: Step as if a gale were at the back so the whole body arrives with the prong.

name: Chime Pinion
description: Hook the trailing edge of a swinging blade and draw it round.

name: Claspbarrage
description: Whip the butt-knob across in a sudden gust of motion that lands before the guard shifts.

name: Vigorous Hiltpoint
description: Hold the stance steady and feel where the air tightens ahead of a lunge.

name: Silencing Handknob
description: Keep the fork on a weapon along one bearing so every pull the opponent makes works against itself.

name: Unyielding Prongbase
description: Meet a heavy cut with the crossbar and a pulse of qi that arrests it like a cold front.

name: Hamstringing Sidehook
description: Veer a quarter turn at the last moment and pull the lunging arm past the target.

name: Thornclasp
description: Snap the fork over a blade in a squall of qi and wrench the weapon from the grip.

name: Wrecking Handknob Barrage
description: Advance a step at a time on a fixed bearing through a storm of blows until the prong lands.

name: Granite Tineleft
description: Jab along one straight line sworn before the step begins and never turn it aside.

name: Staunch Sidehook
description: Set the tines across the direction of the blow so its force slides off to one side.

name: Vaulting Hiltpoint
description: Slide along the edge of the opponent's reach until a gap opens for the prong.

name: Twistbarrage
description: Rap the butt-knob onto the sheltered side of the opponent's guard where the wind does not reach.

name: Resilient Prongbase
description: Roll the sai over the wrist so a burst of cuts is shed one after another.

name: Dense Tinecrook
description: Hold the breath and read the opponent's chest for the lull before the next blow.

name: Tempered Centerprong
description: Drive the prong at a slant across the line of the opponent's attack so it threads the gap.

name: Facetprong
description: Brace the fork on a blade and hold the line while qi settles evenly through the wrists.

name: Compressing Tineright
description: Flick a tine under a hilt in a gust of motion and lift the weapon free.

name: Skinning Wrest
description: Rake the tines across armor in a long shear that peels the lacing off a plate.

name: Slag Sidehook
description: Sweep both sai in a wide flat circle that clears every opponent from the space in front.

name: Wrestassault
description: Hold the sworn line to its end and drive the prong through any guard standing on it.
